title: EUCLID (Digitone step-fire events)
author: Dracyr
description: EUCLID, the smallest step-fire mod for the Digitone mk1: track 1 fires 5 steps of every 16, spread as evenly as they go, whatever its own trigs say; every other track plays as stock. A template for a mod that changes what the sequencer plays: it names no firmware address, so its OS 1.44 port is empty (docs/ADAPTING.md, "Step-fire events"). Needs seq-events.
